Interface InteractionRule

All Known Implementing Classes:
DepositIntoAdjacentStackRule, DepositIntoClickedStackRule, ExtractionRule, ModeCycleRule, PlaceAdjacentGenericRule, RotateBlockWithRedstoneTorchRule, RotateItemWithSoulTorchRule, TogglePermanentRule
public interface InteractionRule
One loader-neutral player gesture. InteractionRuleRegistry walks an ordered list and runs the first rule that matches, so a rule states only its own conditions and relies on its position in that list to settle overlaps with broader rules behind it.

Rules run on the client, which owns gesture recognition. They only decide whether to consume the local click; the vanilla block-use packet carries the action and the server decides whether the gesture is allowed.

  • Method Details

    • matches

      boolean matches(InteractionContext ctx)
      Whether this rule claims the gesture. Called on each rule in turn until one returns true, so it reads state and changes none.

    • execute

      void execute(InteractionContext ctx)
      Acts on the claimed gesture, normally by calling InteractionContext.cancelEvent() to stop duplicate local block or item use. A matched rule ends the walk whether or not it cancels.
